mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary conditions, boosting equity markets.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not exceed historical average when FEDFUNDS is low.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate below 7% signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P returns.
failure_condition: No improvement in returns when UNRATE is below 7%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth and low federal funds rate jointly indicate strong demand and easy money, boosting equities.
failure_condition: No positive returns when both proxies are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment in an expansion regime signals a strong economy, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns do not improve in expansion with low UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, boosting equity returns.
failure_condition: Returns do not follow payroll growth.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 indicate strong demand, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: No positive returns when HOUST exceeds 1000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth alongside GDP growth indicates strong supply and demand, boosting equities.
failure_condition: No positive returns when both proxies grow.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate in a tightening cycle may lead to negative equity returns.
failure_condition: Returns do not decline in tightening cycles.
